mentions.name: Talos K8s homelab migration
mentions.description: A homelab infrastructure migration consolidating the author's workloads from VMs and scattered containers onto a Talos Kubernetes node, replacing a cycle of bespoke builds at home with a standardized setup.
mentions.source_excerpt: Also migrating my workloads from VMs and strewn-about containers onto a Talos K8s node, so I can break the cycle of bespoke builds at home and get back to enjoying projects.
